title: Infant & Child CPR Parameters (2025 PALS)

changelog.change: Initial entry — reflects the Oct 2025 PALS refresh (two-finger infant technique eliminated; diastolic BP targets added).

purpose: Pediatric-specific CPR mechanics and the 2025-refresh changes.
ageRange: Infants (< 1 y) and children (1 y to puberty)

items: Rate 100-120/min; depth ~1/3 of the AP chest diameter
Infant, 2 rescuers: two-thumb encircling technique. Infant, 1 rescuer: heel of one hand. The two-finger technique is eliminated in the 2025 refresh.
Defibrillation 2 J/kg first shock, 4 J/kg subsequent, up to the adult max

body.text: When invasive arterial monitoring is available, target a diastolic BP ≥ 25 mmHg in infants and ≥ 30 mmHg in older children during CPR. Advanced/optional field for arterial-line-capable centres — not a universal requirement.
Despite adequate oxygenation and ventilation: start chest compressions if HR < 60 → epinephrine → atropine ONLY for suspected increased vagal tone or primary AV block.

items: Infant: 5 back blows + 5 CHEST thrusts (not abdominal thrusts)
Child / adult: back blows + abdominal thrusts (Heimlich)
If unresponsive: start CPR, check the mouth for the object before each set of ventilations

buildNote: Cross-links to the peds arrest drug cards for the actual weight-based doses.
